summary: onSave becomes async and writes every note in the store to data/notes.json after each save.

findings.title: Async onSave breaks the synchronous dispatch caller
findings.problem: onSave now returns a Promise, but dispatch in src/router.js:7 returns it without awaiting. The handler in src/main.js:9 then passes that Promise to res.end, which accepts only a string or Buffer.
findings.consequence: res.end throws a type error on every POST /save request, and the uncaught exception crashes the server. No caller handles a writeFile rejection, so it becomes an unhandled rejection.
findings.fix: Make dispatch and the request handler async, and await the result before calling res.end. Catch errors in the request handler and answer with a 500 status.

findings.title: No test covers the new snapshot write
findings.problem: onSave now writes the store to disk and returns a Promise. The repository has no test that exercises onSave or dispatch.
findings.consequence: No test caught the broken save path, and nothing will catch the next regression.
findings.fix: Add a test that calls dispatch with the save action and checks the response text and the snapshot file.
